Guillermo's own take for Mon, Oct 26 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The outflow is on its way out. Pam Rocks read N 21 at 7am, down from 30 at 2am but still ahead of the page’s 18. Pemberton is still 4 hPa above Vancouver, which usually keeps it blowing a few more hours.

Porteau is a maybe until about 10am, on the ebb from 14.9ft. If Pam Rocks reads 22+ from the north at 8am, go. Under 20, stay home.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PDT 26 October 2026): Tonight and Tuesday. Wind light increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots near noon Tuesday.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 04:00 PM PDT 26 October 2026): Tonight and Tuesday. Wind light becoming northwest 15 knots near midnight then diminishing to light Tuesday afternoon. Wind increasing to southeast 10 to 20 Tuesday evening.
